problem_title: Chain wire methods together in Lightning Web Components
problem: According to the documentation here in order to retrieve a list of picklist values for an object we need to pass in a Record Type Id which can be retrieved using the getObjectInfo method. The issue is that these are both wire functions and I cannot figure out how to chain these methods. If I try code like the following: getObjectInfo({ objectApiName: ACCOUNT_OBJECT }) .then(result => { return...
explanation: You have to use dynamic binding: This is mentioned in Use the Wire Service to Get Data . I wrote a mockup that demonstrates this. You should be able to copy-paste this code directly. <template> <template if:true={hasPicklistValues}> <select> <template for:each={picklistValues.data.values} for:item="entry"> <option key={entry.value} value={entry.label}>{entry.label}</option> </template> </select> </template>...
